description: Two terrain textures (grass over dirt, sand over water) to a full 47-tile autotile set with natural, seamless edges, outer and inner corners, plus ready rules: Tiled wang set, Godot 4 TileSet terrains, Unity Rule Tile (editor script), JSON, and a painted preview map. Price: $0.15 USDC via x402, charged only on success. Part of Sprite tools: 2D sprite jobs for games: cut sprites out of their background (exact for one-color backgrounds, AI for busy ones), turn animation videos into aligned sprite sheets, make normal maps for 2D lights, build 47-tile autotile sets with Tiled, Godot and Unity rules, slice a sheet into frames, pack frames into an atlas with TexturePacker and Unity metadata, and turn upscaled or AI-generated pixel art into real pixel art on its true grid with a limited palette..

base.description: Base terrain texture (what is underneath: dirt, water), base64 PNG/JPEG/WebP.

edge.description: soft for painted styles, crisp for pixel art.

edgeWidth.description: How deep the transition sits into a tile, as a fraction of the tile.

rim.description: crisp only: a dark 1 px outline on the top terrain's edge.

top.description: Top terrain texture (what you paint: grass, sand), base64.

name: sprite_tools_autotile
